scope: Drei fehlende Patrizierfiguren für die lokale Venalys-Vorbereitung ergänzen.

records.name: Vinicius
records.design: Muted deep blue, ivory and antique gold. Heavy silver-grey late-Roman lamellar armor combined with fitted Italian knightly breastplate and full arm/leg protection. Noble ivory shoulder cloak with blue lining, blue tabard. HALF OPEN ATTIC-ITALIAN HELMET: swept rounded bronze-edged bowl, short projecting brow, broad separate cheek guards, no feathers, no animal mask; visible calm adult human face with short dark beard. One elegant straight sword held loosely point-down in his right hand, other hand resting at belt. Exact five-petalled ivory flower with gold seed center and small gold stars on BLUE breastcloth, matching the supplied Vinicius emblem. No shield. No flower growing from helmet.

records.name: Tullius
records.design: Muted red, ivory and antique gold. Noble late-Roman bronze muscle cuirass over mail, fully protected silver-grey Italian articulated arms and legs, rich ivory cloak with deep red lining, red and ivory skirt panels. CLOSED DISTINCT ROUNDED ITALIAN-ROMAN VISOR HELMET with smooth low bowl, narrow horizontal eye opening, softly rounded faceplate, tiny gold trim, no feathers, no crest, NO cross finial. Sole weapon is an elegant straight sword upright point-down, both gauntleted hands resting naturally on its pommel. Exact praying ivory hands over alternating red and ivory rays in a small round heraldic breast medallion as supplied Tullius emblem. Religious affiliation conveyed only through this house heraldry and color, no invented clerical rank, no extra holy symbols. No shield.

records.name: Arentino
records.design: Muted dark green, ivory and antique gold. Strong noble silver-grey riveted brigandine with segmented late-Roman lamellar shoulder defenses, ivory sleeves and green hanging tabard, full plated forearms/shins, dark green short cloak. OPEN LATE-ROMAN SPANGENHELM with broad separate cheek plates, short flat longitudinal crest built into metal (NOT a feather plume), visible calm clean-shaven mature human face. One complete elegant halberd held vertically in one hand with its base at the ground, other hand relaxed at belt. Entire halberd head and shaft visible, blade shaped as restrained practical Italian halberd, no fantasy weapon. Ivory castle on green steps with small laurel branches as EXACT house emblem on breast tabard, based on supplied Arentino crest. No shield, no sword in hand, no builder tools.
